lines.en: label kaoridate15p2:
scene kaorimaidcafe1
: This establishment is what I imagine the inside of a strawberry feels like.
lines.zh: : 这家店，就是我想象中草莓的内部会有的那种感觉。

lines.en: : Exciting, right?
lines.zh: : 很让人兴奋，对吧？

lines.en: : Where are we, Friend?
lines.zh: : 我们在哪儿，朋友？

lines.en: : This is a maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 这里是女仆咖啡厅。

lines.en: : I hope they wash their hands before making our food because maids are known to get very dirty.
lines.zh: : 我希望她们做吃的东西之前会先洗手，因为女仆是出了名的会弄得很脏。

lines.en: : Right, because they normally clean.
lines.zh: : 对，因为她们平时是干打扫的。

lines.en: : And perform unspeakable acts on anyone willing to pay them enough money.
lines.zh: : 还会对任何肯出够钱的人，做出不可描述的事情。

lines.en: : Are you going to make me watch you do something strange?
lines.zh: : 你是要让我看你做奇怪的事吗？

lines.en: : If it will make our friendship stronger, I am willing. But I may make strange noises out of interest and/or fear.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让我们的友情更牢固，我愿意。不过我可能会因为好奇和／或害怕，发出奇怪的声音。

lines.en: : You know, I didn’t think you knew about those kinds of maids.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我还以为你不知道有那种女仆呢。

lines.en: : This isn’t that kind of place, though. The maids here just...say and do a bunch of cute stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过这里不是那种店。这儿的女仆只是……说一堆、做一堆可爱的事。

lines.en: : Do you remember Ami?
lines.zh: : 你还记得 Ami 吗？

lines.en: : The pretty girl with the red hair that you were trying to sell the first time you came to the doughnut diner?
lines.zh: : 那个红头发的漂亮女孩，你第一次来甜甜圈餐厅的时候还想把她卖掉的那个？

lines.en: : I wasn’t trying to {i}sell{/i} her...
lines.zh: : 我那不是想{i}卖掉{/i}她……

lines.en: : Do you think she would be friends with John? I have more wealth-paper than I expected to have at this point in the day and I would like to make a purchase if so.
lines.zh: : 你觉得她会和 John 成为朋友吗？我今天这个时候身上的财富纸比预想的多，如果是的话，我想买下她。

lines.en: : You can’t buy my-
lines.zh: : 你不能买我的——

lines.en: : Actually, how much are you willing to spend?
lines.zh: : 等等，你愿意出多少？

lines.en: : I have 50,000 yen moneys right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在有五万日元钱。

lines.en: : You were going to pay 50,000 yen for chickens?
lines.zh: : 你本来打算花五万日元买鸡？

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe2
: I was going to pay for {i}friendship{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我本来是要为{i}友情{/i}付钱的。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. You can have her.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧。她归你了。

lines.en: : Make sure she still comes over to cook me breakfast in the morning, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，要保证她早上还过来给我做早饭。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe3
: My happiness has increased!
lines.zh: : 我的幸福感提升了！

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe4
: But my sadness is still immeasurable because she may be pretty, but does not have any feathers...
lines.zh: : 可我的悲伤依旧无法计量，因为她虽然漂亮，却一根羽毛都没有……

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe5
: Um...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 呃……Sensei？

lines.en: : About time. I had to seat myself because you and Uta were yelling about stuff in the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 你可算来了。我自己找的座位，因为你和 Uta 在厨房里为点什么事大喊大叫。

lines.en: : Well...she brought her beetle to work and...
lines.zh: : 那个……她把她的甲虫带到店里来了，然后……

lines.en: : Actually, that doesn’t matter. Why are you with the spider waitress?...
lines.zh: : 算了，那不重要。你为什么和那个蜘蛛女服务员在一起？……

lines.en: : And why does she look so upset?...
lines.zh: : 还有，她为什么看起来这么难过？……

lines.en: : She just purchased you because she needs a friend for her chicken and is also currently in mourning.
lines.zh: : 她刚刚把你买下来了，因为她需要给她的鸡找个朋友，而且她现在还在服丧。

lines.en: : Woe is the Queen of Spiders.
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛女王，悲哉。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe6
: Master...what’s the meaning of all these weird expressions at one table?
lines.zh: : Master……这一桌这些古怪的表情，都是什么意思啊？

lines.en: : So, my companion here just purchased Ami because she needs a friend for her chicken and is also currently in mourning.
lines.zh: : 是这样的，我旁边这位刚刚把 Ami 买下来了，因为她需要给她的鸡找个朋友，而且她现在还在服丧。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe7
: Works for me!
lines.zh: : 我没问题！

lines.en: : You two on a date or somethin’? Gonna take her back to your place and give her the good ole push and pray?
lines.zh: : 你俩是在约会还是怎么的？打算把她带回家，给她来一套老掉牙的「推倒加祈祷」？

lines.en: : She check in with her mom yet?
lines.zh: : 她跟她妈妈报备过了吗？

lines.en: : Kaori, if Sensei invites you to his house, make sure you say no. Okay?
lines.zh: : Kaori，如果 Sensei 邀请你去他家，一定记得拒绝。好吗？

lines.en: : Of course. If there is anything I have learned about this man, it is that he sells girls your age to the black market and that many of them are likely stored in his very home.
lines.zh: : 当然。要说我对这个男人有什么了解，那就是他会把你这个年纪的女孩卖到黑市，而且其中很多很可能就藏在他自己家里。

lines.en: : That’s absolutely true and you should never go there. Save yourself.
lines.zh: : 这绝对是真的，你千万别去那儿。救救你自己。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. That’s enough badmouthing me for one afternoon.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。一个下午说我坏话，到此为止。

lines.en: : I come to you two with a mission that I was not able to complete myself.
lines.zh: : 我来找你们两个，是为了一个我自己没能完成的任务。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe8
: A mission? That you needed to come here for?
lines.zh: : 任务？还非得跑到这儿来？

lines.en: : Kaori is upset and I am very bad at dealing with sad people.
lines.zh: : Kaori 很难过，而我非常不擅长应付难过的人。

lines.en: : She’s not...upset because of something you did, is she?
lines.zh: : 她不会……是因为你做了什么才难过的吧？

lines.en: : Friendburger told me the worst knock knock joke I’ve ever heard and then asked me to pretend he was dead.
lines.zh: : 朋友堡给我讲了我这辈子听过最烂的敲敲门笑话，然后还让我假装他已经死了。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe9
: {i}That{/i} was how you tried to cheer up a sad girl?
lines.zh: : 你就是用{i}这个{/i}来安慰一个伤心的女孩？

lines.en: : ...It was the other way around. The “pretend I’m dead” part came first.
lines.zh: : ……顺序反了。「假装我死了」那部分在前面。

lines.en: : I am somehow not surprised at all.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么的，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Master, Master, Master...That’s not even close to what you’re supposed to do when somebody leans on you for help.
lines.zh: : Master，Master，Master……别人靠过来找你帮忙的时候，你可不该这么干啊。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe10
: You’ve gotta approach her real nice and soft-like...
lines.zh: : 你得又温柔又轻缓地靠近她……

lines.en: : Mhm, mhm.
lines.zh: : 嗯，嗯。

lines.en: : Then you’ve gotta look deep into her eyes, like there’s nobody else in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 然后你得深深望进她的眼睛，就像这广阔世界里再没有别人。

lines.en: : Mhm!
: And then grab her face as hard as you can and plant one right on her lips.
lines.zh: : 然后用尽全力捧住她的脸，照着她的嘴唇来一下。

lines.en: : And if she opens her mouth, that means it’s okay to slip in a little tongue.
lines.zh: : 如果她张开嘴，那就代表可以悄悄伸一点舌头进去了。

lines.en: : Right! And-
lines.zh: : 对！还有——

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe11
: Wait, no! Are you kidding me?!
lines.zh: : 等等，不对！你在开玩笑吗？！

lines.en: : That’s not even close to what he should be doing to cheer people up!
lines.zh: : 要让人打起精神，他该做的根本不是这种事！

lines.en: : Forcing things like that on girls is assault! I should have you arrested for even suggesting that, Uta-chan!
lines.zh: : 强逼女孩做这种事就是性骚扰！光是提出这种建议，我就该报警把你抓起来，Uta-chan！

lines.en: : Wow, keeping the “chan” in and everything. You’re getting good at this, Ami.
lines.zh: : 哇，「chan」都带上了，全套齐全。你越来越熟练了嘛，Ami。

lines.en: : I’ll get fired if I break character!
lines.zh: : 我要是出戏会被炒鱿鱼的！

lines.en: : Tongue? Mouth? Open? Character?
lines.zh: : 舌头？嘴？张开？角色？

lines.en: : I’ve never done this kiss move before. What if I sneeze?
lines.zh: : 我从来没做过这个亲吻动作。要是我打喷嚏怎么办？

lines.en: : Heheheh...girls. Am I right?
lines.zh: : 呵呵呵……女人啊。我说得对吧？

lines.en: : What does that even mean?...
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？……

lines.en: : {i}You’re racking up new ladies so quickly that you should know exactly what it means, Master.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你勾搭新女人的速度快成这样，你应该最清楚那是什么意思吧，Master。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How many bases have you two touched yet? Three? Four? Five?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你俩已经摸到几个垒了？三垒？四垒？五垒？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You should ask your roommate about how baseball works before referring to it in a sexual manner.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你拿棒球来打性方面的比方之前，应该先去问问你室友棒球是怎么玩的。{/i}

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe12
: My body is prepared!
lines.zh: : 我的身体已经准备好了！

lines.en: : I will accept the tongue now!
lines.zh: : 我现在就接受舌头吧！

lines.en: : Could you two just step aside for a second and-
lines.zh: : 你俩能不能先让开一下，然后——

lines.en: : Not a chance, {i}Master.{/i}
lines.zh: : 想都别想，{i}Master{/i}。

lines.en: : I doubt she’s even upset in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑她一开始根本就没难过。

lines.en: : You’re just playing some sort of trick on Uta and me because you know we have to go along with it.
lines.zh: : 你就是在拿我和 Uta 寻开心，因为你知道我们只能配合你演下去。

lines.en: : I can see through you, {i}Master.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我看穿你了，{i}Master{/i}。

lines.en: : She really is upset, though. She’s dealing with death for the first time in her life.
lines.zh: : 不过她是真的难过。她这辈子第一次面对死亡。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe13
: Do you know what you want to eat yet, Princess Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你想好要吃什么了吗，Kaori 公主？

lines.en: : One chicken sandwich please.
lines.zh: : 请来一份鸡肉三明治。

lines.en: Or...maybe she’s over it already?
lines.zh: 或者……也许她已经缓过来了？

lines.en: : I thought that {i}in mourning{/i} thing was just you exaggerating...I didn’t realize she-
lines.zh: : 我还以为「{i}在服丧{/i}」只是你夸张的说法……没想到她——

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe14
: Do not waste your worry feelings on me, pretty strawberry girl! Just come to my house and rub some cock and everything will be okay!
lines.zh: : 别把你的担心浪费在我身上，漂亮的草莓女孩！来我家揉揉 cock，一切都会好起来的！

lines.en: : ...Excuse me?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: : I think she’s talking about a chicken.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她说的是鸡。

lines.en: : Or at least I {i}hope{/i} she’s talking about a chicken.
lines.zh: : 至少我{i}希望{/i}她说的是鸡。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe15
: Or do I?...
lines.zh: : 还是说，其实我希望的不是这个？……

lines.en: : How about we just...do what we normally do here and make you feel all...welcome and warm inside?
lines.zh: : 要不我们还是……照平时在这儿做的那样，让你感觉……宾至如归、心里暖暖的？

lines.en: : Friend already told me this was not that kind of establishment. But if you think that will make me feel better...okay!
lines.zh: : 朋友已经告诉我这里不是那种店了。不过如果你觉得这样能让我好受些……那就来吧！

lines.en: : I already prepared my body so I will not interfere with your job. I understand that you need to make yen moneys just like everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我的身体已经准备好了，所以我不会妨碍你们工作。我明白你们和所有人一样，都需要挣日元钱。

lines.en: : Yes...by {i}serving you food and saying nice things to you because anything else would be illegal.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是的……就是{i}给你上菜、对你说好话，因为别的什么都算违法{/i}。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe16
: Oh, that’s not true.
lines.zh: : 哦，那可不对。

lines.en: : It’s...not?
lines.zh: : ……不是吗？

lines.en: : Nope! We can do {i}special{/i} stuff for the customers whenever we want as long as they’re willing to pay for it.
lines.zh: : 当然不是！只要客人愿意付钱，我们随时都能为他们做点{i}特别{/i}的事。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe17
: We can?! What?!
lines.zh: : 可以吗？！什么？！

lines.en: : Yeah. I do it for Sensei all the time. He’s basically addicted.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我经常给 Sensei 做。他基本上都上瘾了。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe18
: He is?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！

lines.en: : Yeah. You should see the look on his face whenever I finish. It’s {i}adooooorable.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。你该看看我做完的时候他那副表情。{i}可、爱、死、了{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ve even done it for Maya a few times but she doesn’t seem to be as big of a fan. Except for the one time I did it for them together.
lines.zh: : 我甚至还给 Maya 做过几次，不过她好像没那么热衷。除了那一次，我给他们两个一起做的时候。

lines.en: : She pretended to not like it, but I know she did.
lines.zh: : 她装作不喜欢，可我知道她喜欢。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe19
: AAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!

lines.en: : She’s obviously talking about the flavor beam, Ami.
lines.zh: : 她说的显然是风味光线，Ami。

lines.en: : I FIGURED THAT OUT ALREADY BUT IT’S STILL-
lines.zh: : 我早就反应过来了，可还是——

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe20
: Wait, what do you mean “for them together?” Did Sensei come here with Maya?
lines.zh: : 等等，「给他们两个一起」是什么意思？Sensei 和 Maya 一起来过这儿？

lines.en: : Ah! No! That never happened!
lines.zh: : 啊！没有！那种事从来没发生过！

lines.en: : Just part of the joke! I’ve never seen them together even once!
lines.zh: : 那只是玩笑的一部分！我一次都没见过他们俩在一起！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Kaori. Things are normally a little more...focused than this.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Kaori。平常这里要……正经一点。

lines.en: : I am very confused but having a large amount of fun!
lines.zh: : 我很困惑，但我玩得非常开心！

lines.en: : Well I’m glad you’re no longer being pushed down by the weight of mortality on your...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你不再被死亡的重量压在你的……

lines.en: : Do you have a special word for shoulders?
lines.zh: : 你对肩膀有什么特别的叫法吗？

lines.en: : What is a shoulder?
lines.zh: : 肩膀是什么？

lines.en: : The thing your shoulder tubes are attached to.
lines.zh: : 就是你的肩管接在上面的那个东西。

lines.en: : Ooooooooh. A {i}shoulder.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦——。是{i}肩膀{/i}啊。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe21
: So, uhh...anyway! Princess Kaori! We’re not really supposed to do this but...I know just the thing to perk you right up!
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……总之！Kaori 公主！按规定我们其实不该这么做的，不过……我知道有个东西能让你立刻打起精神！

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’m prepared enough to handle special services from two maids at once!
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己有没有做好准备，同时接受两个女仆的特别服务！

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhh that’s not what I’m talkin’ about!
lines.zh: : 呃——————我说的不是这个！

lines.en: : I was gonna ask if you wanted to try on one of the outfits that Ami and I are wearing.
lines.zh: : 我是想问，你想不想试穿一套我和 Ami 身上穿的这种衣服。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe22
: Sometimes, when I’m feelin’ down...I throw this thing on and look at myself in the mirror and think, “Woah! I can be this cute?!”
lines.zh: : 有时候，我情绪低落的时候……就套上这身，照着镜子想：「哇！我居然可以这么可爱？！」

lines.en: : And then I do a little twirl and a jump thingy and...boom! I stomp those negative emotions into the ground!
lines.zh: : 然后我转个圈、蹦一下，再……砰！那些负面情绪就被我踩进地里了！

lines.en: : I don’t know...the spider will get out if I become a maid.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……如果我当了女仆，蜘蛛会跑出来的。

lines.en: : That’s totally fine. I’ve got a beetle in the back and they can be friends or something! Just put the little guy in a cage and-
lines.zh: : 那完全没问题。我后面有只甲虫，它们可以交个朋友什么的！把那小家伙关进笼子里就——

lines.en: : She’s talking about a tattoo.
lines.zh: : 她说的是纹身。

lines.en: : Yeah...it’s a really big one too. I remember it.
lines.zh: : 是啊……而且那纹身还特别大。我记得。

lines.en: : We’d have to be careful not to let any customers see it.
lines.zh: : 我们得小心，别让任何客人看到。

lines.en: : We can be quick about it if you really wanna try, Princess Kaori. This is a special favor from Uta-chan and Ami-chan that we’re not even gonna charge ya for!
lines.zh: : 如果你真想试，我们可以快点来，Kaori 公主。这是 Uta-chan 和 Ami-chan 给你的特别优待，我们连钱都不收！

lines.en: : We can call it the...sad girl special!
lines.zh: : 我们可以叫它……伤心女孩特供！

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe23
: Do you want me to...give you permission or something?
lines.zh: : 你是要我……给你个许可什么的吗？

lines.en: : If I return as Kaori-chan, will you still be my friend?
lines.zh: : 如果我变回 Kaori-chan，你还会是我的朋友吗？

lines.en: : Of course. In fact, I’ll probably like you even more.
lines.zh: : 当然。事实上，我大概会更喜欢你。

lines.en: : I don’t know if bringing you here gave it away or not, but I kind of have a thing for maids.
lines.zh: : 我不知道带你来这儿有没有暴露什么，不过我算是有那么点女仆情结。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’ve got a real problem, Master. But that’s why we like you so much.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你这毛病可不轻，Master。不过我们就是因为这个才这么喜欢你。

lines.en: : Just for a few hundred seconds then...
lines.zh: : 那就只穿几百秒好了……

lines.en: scene black
Uta grabs Kaori by the wrist and pulls her down the hall into the restroom.
lines.zh: Uta 一把抓住 Kaori 的手腕，拉着她穿过走廊进了洗手间。

lines.en: Ami follows slowly behind, looking back at me once before disappearing in there as well.
lines.zh: Ami 慢慢跟在后面，回头看了我一眼，然后也消失在里面。

lines.en: The two maids exit the restroom three separate times, each time bringing either a new piece of the costume or a replacement for one that didn’t fit and...
lines.zh: 两个女仆前后三次从洗手间出来，每次不是拿来一件新的服装部件，就是拿来一件不合身的替换件，然后……

lines.en: After a few minutes go by...
lines.zh: 几分钟过去之后……

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe24
: Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 哦，我的天。

lines.en: : Okay...that’s long enough, right?
lines.zh: : 好了……时间够长了吧？

lines.en: : Are you in love yet, Master?
lines.zh: : 你爱上她了吗，Master？

lines.en: : Loveburger?!
lines.zh: : 爱情堡？！

lines.en: : That looks really good on you, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 你穿这个真好看，Kaori。

lines.en: : Kaori-{i}chan{/i}. She’s a part of the family now.
lines.zh: : 是 Kaori-{i}chan{/i}。她现在是一家人了。

lines.en: : You don’t...work here now, do you?
lines.zh: : 你现在……不在这里上班吧？

lines.en: : I don’t...think so?
lines.zh: : 我……应该不是吧？

lines.en: : Do I...look strange?
lines.zh: : 我……看起来奇怪吗？

lines.en: : I literally just told you that you look good.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚才说了你很好看。

lines.en: : Does good mean strange?
lines.zh: : 「好看」是「奇怪」的意思吗？

lines.en: : Good means good, Kaori-chan.
lines.zh: : 好看就是好看，Kaori-chan。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe25
: Th...Thank you...Master!
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢你……Master！

lines.en: : Ah! You called him Master and everything! You’re a natural, Kaori-chan!
lines.zh: : 啊！你连「Master」都叫出来了！你真是个天生的料子，Kaori-chan！

lines.en: : Some restaurants require you to address human customers with special human names so I am...just adapting...
lines.zh: : 有些餐厅要求用特殊的人类称呼来叫人类顾客，所以我只是在……适应环境……

lines.en: : That’s a great human answer! I’m so proud of you!
lines.zh: : 这是非常人类化的回答！我太为你骄傲了！

lines.en: Uta really is good at caring for people, huh?
lines.zh: Uta 真的很会照顾人，是吧？

lines.en: : Okaaaaay...that’s definitely long enough...
lines.zh: : 好————吧……这肯定够久了……

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe26
: Us maids can’t really make your troubles go away for good...but we can always help you feel a little better while you’re here.
lines.zh: : 我们做女仆的，没法真正让你的烦恼永远消失……不过你在这儿的时候，我们总能让你好受一点。

lines.en: : So if you ever find yourself wanting a place to relax and forget about stuff, you know where to find us. Kay?
lines.zh: : 所以，要是你哪天想找个地方放松一下、把事情都忘掉，知道上哪儿找我们。好吗？

lines.en: : And also remember that real change comes from within!
lines.zh: : 还有，记住，真正的改变来自内心！

lines.en: : If you’re ever gonna get over whatever hurdle you’re havin’ trouble jumpin’, throw on a cute costume, do a little twirl, and boom!
lines.zh: : 要是你想跨过什么跨不过去的坎，就套上一身可爱的衣服，转个圈，然后砰！

lines.en: : Suddenly you’ll be able to jump a lot higher.
lines.zh: : 突然之间，你就能跳得高多了。

lines.en: : Thank you, tiny raspberry child. This building is very far from the building that I sleep in, so I will likely not come often.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，小小的树莓孩子。这栋楼离我睡觉的那栋楼很远，所以我大概不会常来。

lines.en: : But I will remember you and your soft hands for the rest of my human life.
lines.zh: : 不过我会记住你，还有你这双柔软的手，直到我人类生命的尽头。

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe27
: And you...
lines.zh: : 还有你……

lines.en: : Huh? What about me?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我怎么了？

lines.en: : You just worry about keepin’ {i}your{/i} hands to yourself.
lines.zh: : 你只需要管好{i}自己的{/i}手，别乱动。

lines.en: : This precious angel here’s just like me.
lines.zh: : 这位珍贵的小天使，跟我一模一样。

lines.en: : A total flirt who’s secretly too nervous to ever actually do anything?
lines.zh: : 一个十足的爱调情，其实紧张得什么都不敢真的去做的人？

lines.en: scene kaorimaidcafe28
: No! I mean she’s delicate and you’ve gotta treat her with care!
lines.zh: : 不是！我是说她很脆弱，你得好好珍惜她！

lines.en: : You think I’m nervous?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会紧张？！

lines.en: : An...angel...
: That sounds nice...
lines.zh: : 听起来不错……

lines.en: : Are you feeling better now?
lines.zh: : 你现在好点了吗？

lines.en: : Yes...
: And I am also ready to return to my normal clothes because this outfit is very thin and I am very cold.
lines.zh: : 而且我也准备换回我平时的衣服了，因为这身衣服很薄，我很冷。

lines.en: scene black
The three girls return to the restroom and get Kaori dressed up in her winter clothes again.
lines.zh: 三个女孩回到洗手间，给 Kaori 重新换上了她的冬装。

lines.en: Thankfully, no other customers showed up in the time she’d been out in the open, so there was no commotion surrounding her tattoo or anything like that.
lines.zh: 幸好，她露在外面的这段时间里没有别的客人进来，所以她的纹身什么的没有引起任何骚动。

lines.en: Eventually, Ami and Uta-
lines.zh: 终于，Ami 和 Uta——

lines.en: Or, excuse me, Ami-chan and Uta-chan show up with a whole spread of food to cheer Kaori up that we’re even given a discount on.
lines.zh: 不对，是 Ami-chan 和 Uta-chan 端来了一整桌吃的，想让 Kaori 开心起来，甚至还给我们打了折。

lines.en: It seems like a great gesture at first, and I go through the entire meal feeling rather appreciative for the two of them-
lines.zh: 一开始这看起来是个很棒的举动，整顿饭吃下来，我心里对她们两个都挺感激的——

lines.en: But as Kaori and I begin to head back outside, I notice a handwritten sign on the door advertising the exact “discount” they gave us as a lunch special.
lines.zh: 可就在我和 Kaori 往外走的时候，我注意到门上贴着一张手写的招牌，上面写着她们给我们的那个「折扣」，其实就是午餐特惠。

lines.en: I don’t know why I expected any less given the type of establishment this is...but at least I got to see Kaori get dressed up completely free of charge.
lines.zh: 想想这是家什么店，我也不知道自己为什么还期待更多……不过至少我是完全免费地看到了 Kaori 换装。

lines.en: And that’s worth more than pretty much any discount out there...
lines.zh: 这可比外面几乎任何折扣都值钱……

lines.en: $ kaoridate15p2 = True
$ kaori_love += 1
{i}Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]!{/i}
